claims.text: The PMO states that on Saturday, February 11th, 2006, the Prince Regent, His Royal Highness Crown Prince Tupouto'a, accepted the resignation of the Prime Minister, Prince 'Ulukalala Lavaka Ata. The resignation included all his ministerial portfolios: Telecommunications, Civil Aviation, Marine and Ports, and Disaster Relief Activities.
claims.uncertainty: Records the date the resignation was accepted, not when the resignation letter was written or submitted. The release is dated 13 February 2006, 14:14.

claims.text: The same release states that the Prince Regent also on Saturday 11 February 2006 appointed the Hon. Dr. Feleti Sevele, Minister for Labour, Commerce and Industries, to the post of Acting Prime Minister of Tonga, and that Sevele had been appointed a Minister on 21 March 2005.
claims.uncertainty: An acting appointment made by the Prince Regent, distinct from the later substantive appointment. The end of the acting service is not stated. Recorded as a claim on the role, not as a holder.
